sloka: यद् व्यलीकम् कृतम् पुत्र मात्रा ते यदि वा मया ।न तन् मनसि कर्तव्यम् त्वया तात तपस्विना ॥२-६४-९॥
transliteration: yad vyalīkam kṛtam putra mātrā te yadi vā mayā ।na tan manasi kartavyam tvayā tāta tapasvinā ॥2-64-9॥

translations.english: 'O Child, O Son if your mother or I have done anything disagreeable, do not take it to heart, for you are an ascetic.
